notes:
CRM notes (fragments):
- vertical: hospital systems + teletriage (ED triage + nurse assistants).
- primary ask: low-latency clinical chat at point-of-care (doctor/nurse UI) + fast embedding search over EHR snapshots.
- perf targets: p50 < 20ms inference for short assistant responses, p95 < 80ms, p99 < 150ms for in-clinic triage flows. throughput target: 400 qps sustained for triage tier with spikes to 1k qps.
- cost sensitivity: tight unit economics — looking to keep inference cost below $0.0008 per token (target), aggressive interest in quantization and batching.
- model prefs: prefer open/quantizable models (Llama-4o family, Redwood-2 variants) but need Redwood-verified perf profiles. Will consider smaller fine-tuned family for safety.
- routing/fallback: require regional routing (NA primary, EU fallback), automatic fallback to lighter quantized variants if Dedicated capacity saturated.
- caching/batching: interested in prefix caching of patient context, KV cache reuse across short sessions, workload-aware batching to preserve latency SLOs.
- quantization: test 4-bit + QLoRA fine-tuned ops; need QC on hallucination/regression vs float16.
- security/compliance: strict — on-prem option for EU patient data, SSO + SCIM, audit logs retained 7 years for clinical traceability, integration with customer KMS/HSM.
- benchmarking ask: Redwood to run perf matrix (model variants x batch sizes x quant levels x GPU types) + p99 tail latency traces and memory/KV/cache effectiveness. Replay of 2 weeks of anonymized production traces for realistic batching simulation.
- quote from CTO: 'We cannot trade clinical safety for latency savings; regressions must be provably detected in eval harness.'
- quote from Head of Infrastructure: 'If dedicated racks are cheaper than building our own cluster, we pick Redwood.'
- current feeling: technical + procurement aligned but legal/infosec slower.
- quick links: Fireflies ff-987654321 call has perf sketch; drive deck contains PoC acceptance criteria.
- shorthand next actions: SE to deliver perf matrix template, infra to supply rack specs, legal to circulate DPA redlines.
